title: cells finish accepts --deviation lines written to trace.deviations
action: Friction (2026-08-11): worker deviations narrated in prose never reach trace.deviations, so bee knowledge promote's pattern-candidate mining (which reads only trace.deviations and failure signatures) always reports zero — four real deviations in one day were invisible. Fix: `bee cells finish` (and `cells cap` if finish routes through it — follow the real cap-record writer in handlers_close.rs; declared file is a hypothesis, name the real site) accepts a repeatable `--deviation "<one line>"` flag; each non-empty value is appended to the cell's trace.deviations array at cap time. Empty/whitespace-only values are refused naming the flag. No flag = today's behavior byte-identical (trace.deviations absent or unchanged). Declare the flag in registry_payload.json for both finish and (if it takes it) cap, so the dispatcher accepts it and per-command help shows it; keep tests/registry_contracts.rs green. Verify the mining side actually sees it: one test caps a cell with two --deviation lines then runs the promote mining path (or its unit — find where trace.deviations is read in verbs/knowledge/promote.rs) asserting the deviations surface as pattern candidates. TDD red-first: flag writes the array; empty refused; no-flag byte-identical; mining surfaces it.

truths: finish --deviation lands each line in trace.deviations and promote mining surfaces them
empty deviation refused naming the flag
a finish without the flag is byte-identical to today

artifacts.substantive: flag plumbing plus tests (or the real cap-record site, named in the trace)

trace.outcome: cap/finish accept --deviation (single line per call; batch via pre-existing --deviations-file) appended to trace.deviations; empty refused pre-write; registry + vocabulary ratchet updated with reason; mining proof drives build_promotion end-to-end
